summary: Repair R806 M1/M2 without editing E806. Optional helper accepts only exact receipt bytes, expected hash, explicit ordered station-ID groups and an enabled flag. It returns complete raw grouped branch views or consistent explicit invalid-input/refusal states. All generalized descriptor, coordinate, diagnostic, scoring and runner machinery is removed.
M1: Classify measurement execution using actual paired branch presence, call counts, operation arrays and their consistency. Executed UNKNOWN retains every row/profile, including empty candidate banks. Current accepted branchless UNKNOWN/DISABLED refusal with absent execution, empty operations and explicit reason is NOT_EXECUTED, without invented measurement rows. Contradictions yield UNKNOWN invalid-input with no projection.
M2: Single policy: malformed/unsupported input or malformed required receipt linkage geometry yields UNKNOWN with projection:null and explicit reason; exact raw bytes/reference may remain untrusted evidence. No descriptor is accepted. Finite different headings preserve raw rows because the helper calculates no heading-dependent metrics.
filesProposedOnlyIfLaterAdmitted: One pure receipt grouping module plus its minimal pure tests and usage note; actual paths/implementation are not allocated in this design packet.
flow: Require enabled:true; validate minimal helper fields.
Hash exact supplied bytes and compare external expected digest, then strict UTF-8/JSON parse without reserializing evidence.
Check current receipt schema and execution/branch consistency; classify EXECUTED versus NOT_EXECUTED independently of UNKNOWN top-level status.

For EXECUTED, resolve exact station IDs in both branches and return full raw long/ordered-short objects without field filtering, candidate selection or arithmetic; retain complete original receipt/bytes.
For NOT_EXECUTED, retain refusal and groups as unverified declaration with no measurement rows. For malformed input, return explicit UNKNOWN with projection:null.
cost: Zero recipe/CV calls. Hash and parse one existing receipt, then ID indexing/group references proportional to retained receipt size plus declared references. No image loading or new full/crop allocations; no measured speed or memory claim.
testPlan: Exactly the future pure tests in narrow-contract.json, only after admission; no tests or CV executed during E808.
gate: Root must verify an actual E807 localized reporting gap AND independent acceptance of this exact narrow contract before a separate implementation packet. This proposal does not establish either gate or new scientific acceptance.
